request: Our school library wants a simple catalogue of its books. The librarian should be able to add a book with its title, its author and how many copies the library owns. Students should be able to see all the books, and look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf. A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it when they are done; a student can only return a book they actually borrowed. When every copy of a book is out, nobody else can borrow it until a copy comes back.
summary:
I've built your library catalogue and all the checks I wrote pass. Students can see every book and look at a single book to see its title, its author, how many copies the library owns and how many are still on the shelf. To borrow or return a book, a student gives their name.

**What changed after your message:** I took out the way to add books, as you asked, and nobody can add a book from inside the catalogue. Your own file of books still needs to go into the catalogue's storage file, and nothing for that exists yet. I haven't tested loading a real file.

**Choices I made for you:**
- A student may borrow more than one copy of the same book.
- Names must match exactly when returning, so "Ann" and "ann" count as different students.

**What is refused:**
- Borrowing a book with no copies left on the shelf.
- Returning a book that student hasn't borrowed.
- Borrowing or returning without giving a name.
- Asking for a book that isn't in the catalogue.
messages: I changed my mind: we don't want a way to add books. We will load the books from a CSV file ourselves.
